name: The sandbox, walls
title: The sandbox, concentric walls
story: The factory sends a card in and three walls close around the agent, one at a time, each with the attempt it blocks: a write to the root filesystem stops at the pod wall, a call into the host's kernel at gVisor, and the probe's tries at the internet, the host machine and the metadata address at the network policy; only named hosts pass the gate. The model gateway then sits in that gate with the keys and the budget meter: a call is held at its worst case, sent and booked at its real cost. The agent holds a one-hour gateway identity, no push token and no model key. More calls fill the budget to its cap and a human decides; at the end the factory kills the agent's processes, mints a write token, pushes once, revokes it and deletes the pod as the walls fold away. Only the element the caption names is bright; the picture holds one second and fades out.
